messages:
maria: Quick sync for May 6 webinar social push. Need final X + LinkedIn copy, carousel export, UTMs, and routing tags. Who owns what?
aj: Ill take copy + UTMs. Can do two X variants and two LinkedIn lengths.
sam: Ill export 3-card carousel and hero images (16:9 + 1:1). Uploading to Drive in 15.
leo: Adding a dark hero alt for an A/B. Will upload hero_1x1_dark.png.
maria: Routing plan: X replies -> SDR triage (Lia) within 2 hours; LinkedIn comments with intent keywords -> nurture list. Lia ok?
lia: Yep. Add &hub_tag=x_reply for X links and &hub_tag=li_comment for LinkedIn so HubSpot filtering works.
aj: Example UTM: ?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=web_may6&utm_content=variantA&hub_tag=x_reply. Will generate shortlinks and put in copy doc by EOD.
maria: Proposed schedule (react with :thumbsup: to confirm):
- Wed 09:00 PT X teaser (image A/B)
- Wed 10:00 PT LinkedIn carousel (long copy)
- Wed 12:00 PT X reg CTA (A/B CTA text)
- Thu 11:00 PT LinkedIn speaker highlight

sam: Drive: https://drive.google.com/fake/webinar_may6 (carousel + hero images + alt dark).
aj: Copy variants below. Variant A (playful): "Big models, tiny latency. See our demo May 6 -> short.ly/A"
aj: Variant B (product): "Production LLM inference: reliable, cost-efficient, low-latency. Live demo May 6 -> short.ly/B"
maria: Good. LinkedIn will use product variant plus bullets: runtime, routing, cost controls. Sam confirm slide order: 1 problem 2 solution 3 demo CTA?
sam: Confirmed. Exporting now.
maria: A/B tests: creative (dark vs light hero) and CTA text ("Save your spot" vs "See the demo live"). Track CTR and registrations over first 72h.
lia: SDR playbook: monitor X thread, respond to product questions, escalate SQLs to SDR queue with hub_tag.
scheduler-bot: Drafts created: X 2026-05-06 09:00 PT (teaser), LinkedIn 2026-05-06 10:00 PT (carousel), X 2026-05-06 12:00 PT (reg CTA). Status: pending copy approval.
maria: Final ask: AJ drop final copy in the doc and tag scheduler when ready. Ill review in 30m. Any blockers?
leo: none.
lia: monitoring setup.
aj: on it.
maria: Thanks team :calendar:"
